d:
Well, it wasn’t exactly the cartoon of my childhood, but the moment my fiancé mentioned the whole idea and universe, I immediately got excited about how much potential it has for a kinky twist! It took me a while to do the research and model work, but most of the time actually went into developing the story choices. I’m sure it’s pretty kinky - but I’m also pretty sure the transformations are wildly unbalanced.

As for the rules - we play as if we were the owner of the watch, initially able to transform into just one alien. You can use it for your own naughty purposes or take advantage of the special abilities to become a famous kinky superhero.

I hope you’ll enjoy the fantastical vibe and the universe itself (I’m betting some of you already know it 😉).
